action_ru: Сверить ID MFG-004, ревизию, серийный номер, схему каналов и дату калибровки.
action_en: Verify MFG-004 ID, revision, serial number, channel map and calibration date.

action_ru: Без DUT измерить сопротивление каждого pogo до соответствующего контакта интерфейсного разъема.
action_en: Without a DUT, measure resistance from every pogo pin to its interface connector contact.
engineering_target: <= 1 ohm including fixture leads

action_ru: Без DUT проверить отсутствие замыкания каждого сигнального канала на соседние каналы и землю.
action_en: Without a DUT, verify isolation from every signal channel to adjacent channels and ground.
engineering_target: >= 10 Mohm for fixture wiring only
safety_note: Do not perform insulation mode with a DUT installed.

action_ru: Проверить базирование по H1-H4, ориентационный ключ, совпадение 31 pogo с площадками и ход контактов.
action_en: Verify H1-H4 datum, orientation key, alignment of all 31 pogo pins and contact travel.

action_ru: Проверить, что все выходы оснастки высокоомны до valid VTREF, а аварийное отключение снимает питание DUT и CELL_USB_VBUS.
action_en: Verify all fixture outputs remain high impedance until valid VTREF and the emergency stop removes DUT and CELL_USB_VBUS power.

action_ru: Сверить DIO-EVT-B01, station ID 901, tenant bench, PCB serials, ревизии и release manifest.
action_en: Verify DIO-EVT-B01, station ID 901, bench tenant, PCB serials, revisions and release manifest.
evidence_required: identity photo and manifest verification log

action_ru: Измерить сопротивление TP_EOL.2 относительно TP_EOL.1 на обесточенной плате.
action_en: Measure resistance from TP_EOL.2 to TP_EOL.1 on the unpowered board.
engineering_target: Characterize and approve from B01 plus golden unit

action_ru: Измерить сопротивление TP_EOL.3 относительно TP_EOL.1 на обесточенной плате.
action_en: Measure resistance from TP_EOL.3 to TP_EOL.1 on the unpowered board.
engineering_target: Characterize and approve from B01 plus golden unit

action_ru: Измерить сопротивление TP_EOL.4 относительно TP_EOL.1 на обесточенной плате.
action_en: Measure resistance from TP_EOL.4 to TP_EOL.1 on the unpowered board.
engineering_target: Characterize and approve from B01 plus golden unit

action_ru: Подать питание через штатный J_PWR_IN от лабораторного источника с утвержденным ограничением тока. Зафиксировать пусковой и установившийся ток.
action_en: Power through the normal J_PWR_IN input using a current-limited bench supply. Record inrush and steady current.
instrument: bench supply, current logger, thermal camera
engineering_target: 10.0 to 14.6 V provisional input envelope; current limit from approved power traveller
safety_note: Stop immediately on current limit, odor, hot spot or reset loop.

action_ru: Измерить 3V3_DIGITAL на TP_EOL.2 относительно TP_EOL.1 во время старта и после стабилизации.
action_en: Measure 3V3_DIGITAL at TP_EOL.2 relative to TP_EOL.1 during startup and steady state.
engineering_target: 3.3 V nominal

action_ru: Измерить 3V8_MODEM на TP_EOL.3 относительно TP_EOL.1 в состояниях modem off, startup и traffic burst.
action_en: Measure 3V8_MODEM at TP_EOL.3 relative to TP_EOL.1 with modem off, during startup and during a traffic burst.
engineering_target: 3.8 V nominal; every U8 VBAT pad must remain >= 3.3 V in EVT-PWR-01

action_ru: Измерить 1V8_MIC на TP_EOL.4 относительно TP_EOL.1 в AAD idle, PDM start и active capture.
action_en: Measure 1V8_MIC at TP_EOL.4 relative to TP_EOL.1 in AAD idle, PDM startup and active capture.
engineering_target: 1.8 V nominal

action_ru: Наблюдать TP_EOL.7 относительно TP_EOL.1. Не подавать сигнал извне.
action_en: Observe TP_EOL.7 relative to TP_EOL.1. Do not drive this contact.
engineering_target: inactive until rails are valid, then stable active state per PCB-PWR contract

action_ru: Наблюдать TP_EOL.8 относительно TP_EOL.1 при нормальном запуске и разрешенной имитации отказа.
action_en: Observe TP_EOL.8 relative to TP_EOL.1 during normal startup and an approved fault injection.
engineering_target: inactive in normal operation and active for the approved known fault
safety_note: Sense only. Use a safe fault simulator.

action_ru: Считать TP_EOL.10 и TP_EOL.11 относительно TP_EOL.1 и сопоставить REV0/REV1 с traveller.
action_en: Read TP_EOL.10 and TP_EOL.11 relative to TP_EOL.1 and match REV0/REV1 to the traveller.
engineering_target: Exact strap code from released PCB revision

action_ru: Измерить idle уровень выхода DUT_TX на TP_EOL.5 относительно TP_EOL.1 до подключения приемника оснастки.
action_en: Measure DUT_TX idle level at TP_EOL.5 relative to TP_EOL.1 before connecting the fixture receiver.
engineering_target: 3.3 V logic domain

action_ru: После valid VTREF подключить прием оснастки к TP_EOL.5 и 3.3 V tolerant выход оснастки к TP_EOL.6. Выполнить help, identity и self-test.
action_en: After valid VTREF, connect the fixture receiver to TP_EOL.5 and a 3.3 V tolerant fixture output to TP_EOL.6. Run help, identity and self-test.
engineering_target: No framing error; exact identity; required self-tests return PASS
safety_note: Fixture TX remains high impedance until TP_EOL.2 is valid.

action_ru: Через TP_EOL.12 и TP_EOL.13 выполнить guarded open-drain scan и чтение INA226 по адресу 0x40.
action_en: Use TP_EOL.12 and TP_EOL.13 for a guarded open-drain scan and INA226 readback at address 0x40.
engineering_target: INA226 0x40 responds and readings agree with reference instrument within the approved calibration limit
safety_note: Do not add pull-ups unless separately enabled and documented.

action_ru: Подтвердить high-Z TP_EOL.9 при свободном NRST. Для recovery сначала прижать NRST на TP_MCU_SWD.4, затем задать BOOT0 через TP_EOL.9, отпустить NRST и после старта вернуть BOOT0 в high-Z.
action_en: Confirm TP_EOL.9 is high impedance while NRST is released. For recovery assert NRST at TP_MCU_SWD.4, drive BOOT0 through TP_EOL.9, release NRST and return BOOT0 to high impedance after startup.
engineering_target: System memory enumerates and normal boot recovers after BOOT0 release
safety_note: Never drive BOOT0 unless NRST is asserted first.

action_ru: Измерить TP_MCU_SWD.1 относительно TP_MCU_SWD.5. ST-LINK не должен питать DUT.
action_en: Measure TP_MCU_SWD.1 relative to TP_MCU_SWD.5. ST-LINK must not power the DUT.
engineering_target: 3.3 V logic domain

action_ru: Подключить 5 GND, 1 VTREF, 4 NRST, 2 SWDIO, 3 SWCLK. Считать device ID и option bytes, затем program, verify и cold boot.
action_en: Connect 5 GND, 1 VTREF, 4 NRST, 2 SWDIO and 3 SWCLK. Read device ID and option bytes, then program, verify and cold boot.
engineering_target: STM32U585VIT6Q, exact bench option-byte profile, exact image SHA-256 and verify PASS
evidence_required: programmer log, option bytes before and after

action_ru: Измерить TP_BLE_SWD.1 относительно TP_BLE_SWD.4. Отладчик не должен питать DUT.
action_en: Measure TP_BLE_SWD.1 relative to TP_BLE_SWD.4. The debugger must not power the DUT.
instrument: DMM and nRF probe VTREF sense
engineering_target: 3.3 V logic domain

action_ru: Подключить 4 GND, 1 VTREF, 2 NRF_SWDIO, 3 NRF_SWCLK. Выполнить erase, program merged.hex, verify, reset и MCUboot signed image check.
action_en: Connect 4 GND, 1 VTREF, 2 NRF_SWDIO and 3 NRF_SWCLK. Erase, program merged.hex, verify, reset and check the MCUboot signed image.
engineering_target: Exact nRF target and signed/merged image hashes; verify and BLE startup PASS

action_ru: После штатного включения BG95 измерить VREF_1V8 на TP_CELL_DBG.1 относительно TP_CELL_DBG.5.
action_en: After normal BG95 power-up, measure VREF_1V8 at TP_CELL_DBG.1 relative to TP_CELL_DBG.5.
engineering_target: 1.8 V modem I/O domain
safety_note: Sense only. All debug outputs remain high impedance until VREF is valid.

action_ru: После valid VREF подключить 1.8 V tolerant RX оснастки к TP_CELL_DBG.2 и 1.8 V output оснастки к TP_CELL_DBG.3. Выполнить AT и прочитать версию.
action_en: After valid VREF, connect the fixture 1.8 V tolerant RX to TP_CELL_DBG.2 and the 1.8 V fixture output to TP_CELL_DBG.3. Run AT and read the version.
engineering_target: AT returns OK and the approved BG95 identity/version is recorded

action_ru: В обычном режиме проверить LOW на TP_CELL_DBG.4. Для recovery подать current-limited 1.8 V HIGH только по утвержденной последовательности power-on, затем вернуть high-Z.
action_en: Verify LOW at TP_CELL_DBG.4 in normal operation. For recovery apply a current-limited 1.8 V HIGH only during the approved power-on sequence, then return high impedance.
engineering_target: Normal LOW and recovery enumeration PASS
safety_note: Never apply 3.3 V. Normal fixture state is high impedance.

action_ru: Подключить TP_CELL_USB.4 к modem ground, затем differential D+ к .2, D- к .3 и только после этого current-limited HOST_VBUS к .1. Проверить recovery USB enumeration.
action_en: Connect TP_CELL_USB.4 to modem ground, then differential D+ to .2, D- to .3 and only then current-limited HOST_VBUS to .1. Verify recovery USB enumeration.
engineering_target: BG95 recovery interface enumerates and remains isolated from J11
evidence_required: USB descriptor log and current trace
safety_note: TP_CELL_USB.1 is the only allowed fixture source in the pogo groups. Never join it to J11 VBUS.

action_ru: При снятом питании проверить отсутствие непрерывности между TP_CELL_USB D+/D-/VBUS и J11 USB_DP/USB_DM/USB_VBUS_CONN.
action_en: With power removed verify no continuity between TP_CELL_USB D+/D-/VBUS and J11 USB_DP/USB_DM/USB_VBUS_CONN.
engineering_target: NO_CONTINUITY

action_ru: На J_MIC1-J_MIC4 измерить pin 1 1V8_MIC относительно pin 2 GND в AAD idle и active PDM.
action_en: At J_MIC1-J_MIC4 measure pin 1 1V8_MIC relative to pin 2 GND in AAD idle and active PDM.
engineering_target: 1.8 V nominal on all four harnesses

action_ru: На pin 3 каждого J_MIC измерить общий PDM_CLK относительно pin 2, включая запуск и останов для AAD.
action_en: At pin 3 of every J_MIC measure common PDM_CLK relative to pin 2, including AAD start and stop.
engineering_target: Clock exceeds 50 kHz during THSEL/PDM operation; final frequency and edges use approved target limit

action_ru: Проверить PDM_DATA1-4 на pin 4 J_MIC1-4, отсутствие dropout и соответствие физическому MIC1-MIC4.
action_en: Verify PDM_DATA1-4 at pin 4 of J_MIC1-4, no dropouts and correct physical MIC1-MIC4 mapping.
engineering_target: Four distinct channels, correct 3+1 mapping, zero dropout in the approved capture
evidence_required: WAV, mapping CSV and scope trace

action_ru: На pin 5 J_MIC1-4 измерить MIC_WAKE1-4 и проверить агрегированное пробуждение PA8 при калиброванном событии.
action_en: At pin 5 of J_MIC1-4 measure MIC_WAKE1-4 and verify aggregate PA8 wake on a calibrated event.
engineering_target: Every valid event wakes the station; false wake and latency meet approved acoustic limits

action_ru: На pin 6 J_MIC1-4 проверить общий AAD_CFG/THSEL, stop symbol и возврат линии в штатное состояние.
action_en: At pin 6 of J_MIC1-4 verify common AAD_CFG/THSEL, the stop symbol and return to the normal state.
engineering_target: T5838 protocol timing and common-bus behavior pass

action_ru: Через self-test проверить QSPI JEDEC/SFDP, microSD detect, CID, write/read SHA-256 и восстановление после прерванной записи.
action_en: Use self-test to verify QSPI JEDEC/SFDP, microSD detect, CID, write/read SHA-256 and interrupted-write recovery.
instrument: station UART and controlled power cut
engineering_target: W25Q512JV EF 40 20, 64 MiB; approved industrial microSD

action_ru: До передачи установить 50 ohm loads или утвержденные антенны на J8 LTE, J9 GNSS и J10 LoRa. Сверить U.FL и кабели.
action_en: Before transmission install 50 ohm loads or approved antennas at J8 LTE, J9 GNSS and J10 LoRa. Verify U.FL connectors and cables.
engineering_target: Correct port, cable, load and region
safety_note: No LTE or LoRa transmission into an open connector.

action_ru: Подключить GNSS к J9, получить fix и измерить PPS/time quality и holdover.
action_en: Connect GNSS at J9, obtain a fix and measure PPS/time quality and holdover.
instrument: GNSS simulator or approved antenna, oscilloscope
engineering_target: Limits approved after B01 characterization

action_ru: На J10 в conducted или экранированной оснастке проверить RU868 profile, SPI, packet integrity, frequency and power. Вне стенда TX запрещен.
action_en: At J10 in a conducted or shielded fixture verify the RU868 profile, SPI, packet integrity, frequency and power. TX is prohibited outside the fixture.
engineering_target: Approved RU868 limits
safety_note: Use conducted or shielded RF setup only.

action_ru: На J8 с утвержденной антенной или нагрузкой выполнить attach, TLS, MQTT, heartbeat, event, receipt, reconnect и SIM failover в tenant bench.
action_en: At J8 with an approved antenna or load run attach, TLS, MQTT, heartbeat, event, receipt, reconnect and SIM failover in the bench tenant.
instrument: cellular test setup and dioneya.ru bench
engineering_target: Exact B01 identity; CA and hostname verified; event stored once; no effect on production tenant
evidence_required: redacted modem, station and server logs

action_ru: Проверить signed A/B update, interruption at 10, 30, 70 and 99 percent, trial, confirmation, watchdog rollback and BOOT0/SWD recovery.
action_en: Verify signed A/B update, interruption at 10, 30, 70 and 99 percent, trial, confirmation, watchdog rollback and BOOT0/SWD recovery.
engineering_target: All fault injections recover without unsigned boot

action_ru: Запустить полный self-test 1-13, сохранить CBOR/декодированный результат и failed mask.
action_en: Run complete self-test IDs 1-13 and save the CBOR/decoded result and failed mask.
engineering_target: All required registered tests PASS; failed mask 0
evidence_required: raw CBOR, decoded JSON and station log

action_ru: Выполнить все обязательные EOL, полный регрессионный прогон, проверить evidence и хэши, затем получить две независимые подписи.
action_en: Complete all mandatory EOL tests, full regression, evidence and hash verification, then obtain two independent approvals.
engineering_target: No OPEN, NOT_RUN, FAIL or HOLD mandatory row
